test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which digital initiative improved India's Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) in "Starting a Business"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MCA21**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MCA21** is a flagship e-governance initiative by the **Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA)**, designed to provide secure and anytime/anywhere access to MCA services for businesses and the public.
 
• The project was instrumental in improving India's ranking in the **World Bank's Ease of Doing Business (EoDB)** index, specifically under the **Starting a Business** parameter.
 
• It automated the entire lifecycle of a company, from **incorporation** and **registration** to the filing of annual returns and compliance documents, significantly reducing the time and cost involved.
 
• Key enhancements like the **SPICe+ (Simplified Proforma for Incorporating Company Electronically Plus)** web form integrated multiple services such as **PAN**, **TAN**, **EPFO**, **ESIC**, and **Professional Tax** into a single application.
 
• The system introduced the **Director Identification Number (DIN)** and electronic filing using **Digital Signature Certificates (DSC)**, ensuring transparency and accountability in corporate governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digi Locker**:

 
 
• A key initiative under the **Digital India** program aimed at the **Paperless Governance** concept.
 
• It allows citizens to store and access digital versions of authentic documents like **Driving Licenses**, **Aadhaar**, and **Marksheets** in a secure cloud-based platform.
 
 
 
• **Udyam Portal**:
 
 
• Launched by the **Ministry of MSME** to simplify the registration process for **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises**.
 
• It provides a permanent registration number and a digital certificate, replacing the older **Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM)**.
 
 
 
• **GST Portal**:
 
 
• A unified platform for managing **Goods and Services Tax** compliance across India.
 
• Functions include **taxpayer registration**, **filing returns**, **tax payment**, and processing **refunds**, consolidating various indirect taxes into one interface.
